title: feat(model-monitor): add favorites/star toggle and persistent filters
author: YoannDev90
pr_body_excerpt:
- Star toggle on each model row with localStorage persistence (`model-monitor-favorites` key)
- 'Favorites only' filter toggle with count badge, appears when ≥1 model is favorited
- Favorites-first sorting regardless of active sort column
- Filter composes with existing category tabs (e.g. Image + Favorites shows only favorited image models)
- Empty state message updated for favorites filter
- Scope and category tabs persisted across reloads (`model-monitor-filter` key), validated against known scopes/types
- No regressions to existing sort/filter/window behavior

Co-authored-by: CloudCompile <201248601+CloudCompile@users.noreply.github.com>
Fixes #12579

gist.headline: Starred models stay starred
gist.blurb: The model monitor grew a little bookmark garden. Star the models worth returning to, and the view remembers where you left your pollen.
gist.summary: Model Monitor now supports persistent per-model favorites, a Favorites-only filter with a count badge, favorites-first sorting, and saved scope/category tabs via localStorage.
gist.impact: Users can star the models they use most, combine Favorites with category filters such as Image, and return after a reload to the same saved view.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy model-monitor terminal as a garden catalog, with a row of small model cards marked by glowing star pins. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully stars favorite cards while a few chosen code-plants bloom at the front of the shelf; the rest remain neatly organized behind category tabs.
